description: Na₂MnCl₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pbam space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six Cl atoms. There are a spread of Na-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.78-2.94 Å. Mn is bonded to six Cl atoms to form edge-sharing MnCl₆ octahedra. There are two shorter (2.49 Å) and four longer (2.58 Å) Mn-Cl bond lengths. There are two inequivalent Cl sites. In the first Cl site, Cl is bonded to four equivalent Na and one Mn atom to form distorted ClNa₄Mn trigonal bipyramids that share corners with five equivalent ClNa₄Mn trigonal bipyramids, corners with eight equivalent ClNa₂Mn₂ trigonal pyramids, edges with four equivalent ClNa₄Mn trigonal bipyramids, and edges with two equivalent ClNa₂Mn₂ trigonal pyramids. In the second Cl site, Cl is bonded to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Mn atoms to form distorted ClNa₂Mn₂ trigonal pyramids that share corners with eight equivalent ClNa₄Mn trigonal bipyramids, corners with four equivalent ClNa₂Mn₂ trigonal pyramids, edges with two equivalent ClNa₄Mn trigonal bipyramids, and edges with two equivalent ClNa₂Mn₂ trigonal pyramids.
